LESSON: SARUFI 1.4.3 VIVUMISHI

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya nomino ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno
2. kutambua nomino katika kundi la maneno na sentensi
3. kutumia nomino kwa njia sahihi katika sentensi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya nomino ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya nomino ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua nomino katika kundi la maneno na sentensi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua nomino katika kundi la maneno na sentensi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia nomino kwa njia sahihi katika sentensi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia nomino kwa njia sahihi katika sentensi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya nomino ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya nomino ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno
2. kutambua nomino katika kundi la maneno na sentensi
3. kutumia nomino kwa njia sahihi katika sentensi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
